title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and upgrade GitHub Actions tooling to Node 20
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: consolidate multiple repo-level GitHub Actions workflows (lint, test, release automation) into a smaller set of reusable composites to reduce duplication, improve caching, and standardize on Node 20 and modern Actions versions. This PR: 1) consolidates lint/test workflows across packages into single repo-level workflows with matrix reduction and targeted triggers; 2) extracts reusable composite actions for node-setup, install-cache, and report-upload to reduce YAML duplication; 3) upgrades actions (actions/checkout, actions/cache, actions/setup-node) and standardizes Node toolchain to 20.x; 4) reduces CI minutes by improving cache keys and moving heavy integration tests to a dedicated perf gate; 5) fixes Windows runner path issues seen in recent flakes; 6) updates release automation to use consolidated release workflow and adds a release dry-run step for protected branches; 7) adds docs/ci/README.md describing the new structure and migration notes. Checklist: - [x] run full lint/test matrix on fork - [x] validate release dry-run - [x] confirm compatibility for redwood, sdk, and docs repos - [x] update docs and changelog references.

patch_notes: Replaced duplicate YAML with composites; standardized Node 20; improved cache keys reducing CI runtime on average by ~25%; release automation now runs a dry-run and uses a single canonical workflow; fixed Windows runner path bug that caused sporadic test failures.

release_notes: - Consolidated CI workflows and introduced reusable composite actions to reduce YAML duplication. - Upgraded GitHub Actions toolchain to Node 20 and updated common actions to recommended versions. - Improved caching strategy reducing average CI runtime by ~25%. - Fixed Windows runner path issue that caused intermittent flakes.
notes: Follow-up tasks: monitor CI duration for 2 weeks, pilot consolidated workflows in redwood-sdk repositories, and open a small follow-up to migrate any remaining repo-specific overrides to inputs to composites.
